Planning Document: docs/dcps/INNERWEST/leichhardt/Leichhardt DCP 2013 - 14 - Appendix B Building Typologies - with IWLEP 2022 amendments.pdf

Clause C1 - heritage (development_control): Development shall:
a. retain the simple character and proportions of the elevations visible from the street;
b. maintain the original form and integrity of the building as it presents to the street and public domain; and
c. restore, reconstruct, protect and maintain original details.

Clause C1 - other (development_control): Sandstone or brick wall surfaces are not to be painted or rendered.

Clause C1 - heritage (development_control): Original façade openings and/or detailing which are visible from the street are to be retained;

Clause C1 - heritage (development_control): Alterations to elevation openings visible from the public domain, forms and/or detailing (including external hoods, shutters and the like) may only be approved where there is evidence that such details previously existed at that property.

Clause C1 - heritage (development_control): Original forms and details are to be reconstructed where there is evidence that they existed at that property. Unsympathetic changes are to be reversed.

Clause 1.1 - height_limit (development_control): A detached pavilion with lightweight link, one or two storeys maintains the integrity of the simple, single storey building form and its roof profile when set back on the site.

Clause 1.2 - height_limit (development_control): The rear wing addition can preserve the streetscape presentation of the house if set below the ridge line and if it is not prominent in oblique views between buildings.

Clause C1 - heritage (development_control): Development shall:
a. retain the curtilage and setting of the cottage;
b. retain the presentation and form of the building to the street; single storey scale, roof form and façade proportions; and c. restore, protect and maintain original details of the house and fence.
